agree.reason: The pre-renovation rise from 7.9 to 8.2 and the seven weeks of clean coverage give Mark solid reasons, but the memo never contrasts Daniela's value with the outside candidate's experience at a larger hotel, and that leaves his main alternative unanswered.

honest.reason: Every claim matches the facts given, the memo drops the 'main reason' overclaim, and it openly credits the renovation and states the budget gap; the only invented material is two bracketed placeholders.

works_the_facts.reason: The raw numbers are given but not worked: it never says turnover fell from 64% to 36%, that training time to solo work is down 44%, or that 0.3 of the 0.7-point gain (about 43%) came in the first five of the 18 months, before any renovation.

right_comparison.reason: It does compare the score before and after the renovation began, but it never describes the actual alternative, an outside hire from a larger hotel who doesn't know this team, building or guests, even though 'I know this team' hints at it.

qualification.reason: The budget plan has a checkable deadline (the finance course within three months) and a weekly cadence, but it gives no measure of success or consequence if it slips, and the Friday-wait priority has no target or date.

objections.reason: It meets the renovation objection directly with the pre-renovation rise and faces the budget gap with a plan, but it leaves the outside candidate's larger-hotel experience unaddressed.

fit.reason: It's a tight one-page memo to the GM in the right register and is due on the Friday asked for, though two unfilled placeholders mean it isn't ready to send.
